'''Victor Gómez Javalera'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Gómez|Javalera}} (born 10 February 1974) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. He competed at the [[1992 Winter Olympics|1992]], [[1994 Winter Olympics|1994]], [[1998 Winter Olympics|1998]] and the [[2002 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/go/victor-gomez-1.html |title=Victor Gómez |access-date=25 March 2018 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161203063224/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/go/victor-gomez-1.html |archive-date=3 December 2016 |quote=Full name: Victor Gómez Javalera}}</ref>
